_readme: Authored content for Batch playforce_new (rule 18: content as data, never ad-hoc writes). One entry per matched invoice.
Each coding_note restates what the invoice face prints for that document (job number and type, site, contract, order,
contact, completion date and the priced lines) and states whether the printed PK equals the PK charged on the register.
No amount here is inferred: every figure is the printed one, and the corpus gates GREEN with all 109 documents at TIE.
76 of the 109 documents carry no line on this register: every one is dated before 1-Jul-2026 and belongs to the
PS & WP register's earlier years (outside_playforce_new_v6.json). A further 22 are already sighted here and are held
by the rule 12 evidence screen rather than captured twice.
